name: skills-tooling
description: Repo-level tooling: git hooks, commit message and Markdown linting, skill validation.

scripts.check:skills: for dir in skills/*/; do uvx --from 'git+https://github.com/agentskills/agentskills@69ef37e9424c0a7ea9dd2293b559e43ec8176379#subdirectory=skills-ref' skills-ref validate "$dir" || exit 1; done && DISABLE_TELEMETRY=1 pnpm dlx skills@1.7.4 add . --list
